title: Cenote Jaguar, Akumal - Expéditions Yuc 95/96
credits: Cenote Jaguar (Akumal), plan and sections; topo J.A. Laclette, Edsel Rios, C. Thomas, Germano; développement 800 m. Cenotes du Yucatan: Expéditions de 1995 et 1996, p. 61 (1996), reprinted in AMCS Activities Newsletter 35, p. 26 (2012)
sistemaWhy: Linked by the user (2026-10-02) after review on the satellite: this map's cenote is the database's Jaguar (aka Zacate, -KPZkVKT85x9cn3QFrQ8), in sistema Sac Actun. No sistema of the database is this cave for sure. The database's only 'Jaguar' (-KPZkVKT85x9cn3QFrQ8, aka Zacate, Ejido Jacinto Pat, area Nohoch Nah Chich, sistema Sac Actun) is OSM's 'Cenote El Jaguar' collapse, about 8 km SW of Akumal; the import already rejected Sac Actun for this map. The database's 'Casa del Jaguar' (2,419 m, 2012), 'Cenote Jaguar 2' (65 m, 2014) and 'Cenote Balam' sistemas have no caves and no position; Chac Mool ('The Jaguar Cenote' in Gerrard, halocline 12 m) is in Puerto Aventuras and already has its own map.
placementWhy: Guess, see unverified. Scale from the 0-100 m bar (x 177-625 at y 1133: 0.2232 m/px; its 50 m tick at x 400 agrees; the traced plan, about 480 x 100 m with its branches, fits the 800 m développement), north up ('Nord mg.', magnetic, 1996: a degree or two off true, not corrected). One point: the centre of the map's hatched collapse (Entrée) put on the north pond of the Jacinto Pat Jaguar collapse; the database's Jaguar point falls 49 m N of it, on the parking clearing. Checks, neither confirming nor ruling out the guess: the real collapse runs about 200 m further south to a second pond (OSM 'Cenote El Jaguar') that the map does not show; at this placement the map's west gallery crosses, without a junction, the NE line of the QRSS 2012 Sac Actun overview (sac-actun-mpo-tulum, a 9 m/px small-scale map), whose line ends about 20 m north of it; no other placed map is within 440 m. Reviewed on the satellite by the user (2026-10-02) and accepted: no longer unverified (it was: No cenote of the map has a reliable position, and nothing but the name links it to a place: the map shows no road, coast or other cenote, only the one collapse (about 75 x 60 m). The database has no Cenote Jaguar near Akumal (none of Akumal's caves is named Jaguar or Balam), and no placed map near A).

entrances.why: The map's only opening to the surface, labelled Entrée. Not matched to a database cave: the database's Jaguar (-KPZkVKT85x9cn3QFrQ8, Ejido Jacinto Pat) is probably another cenote. caveId: the database's Jaguar (Zacate), linked by the user.

trace.why: b/w hand drawing: walls are smooth bold lines (about 5 px), passages left white; the collapse is a hatched outline (ticks inward) with an inner hatched cliff line, traced as walls with their ticks. The walls are smooth enough that the straight-line eraser took long runs of them: it is off (straightMinPx 2000) and the three section lines (A, B, C) are erased by hand instead (eraseLines), leaving the few pixels where they cross a wall.

symbols.why: French expedition map (Yuc 95/96): depths written with a minus sign (-7, -12 in the west gallery), a halocline depth (-11, east passage), Impenetrable at the east end (marked with dots), Entrée at the collapse. No legend, no letter codes, no flow arrows and no bones (checked by eye; OCR words checked too).
